description: This file defines the TestExpression class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node for test expressions in the Twig's abstract syntax tree (AST). It includes methods for construction, deprecation handling, and compilation of test expressions.

classes.name: TestExpression
classes.description: Represents a test expression node within Twig's AST, capable of handling test evaluation and compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TestExpression node with dependencies on a node, test type, optional arguments, and line number; handles deprecation warnings.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the test expression node into PHP code, managing callable attributes and deprecation rules.
